(457)༄༅/ /zab chos ni gu chos drug gi brgyud 'debs nyung 'dus bde chen 'bebs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /kun khyab thams cad bdag nyid rdo rje 'cha

tei:div.tei:p: zab chos ni gu chos drug gi brgyud 'debs nyung 'dus bde chen 'bebs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /kun khyab thams cad bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang*// gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa ni gu ma// mthar thug lnga ldan khyung po dzo ki'i zhabs// mchog dngos grub pa'i rgyal po rmog lcog pa// rgyun mtha'i byang sems dbon ston skyer sgang pa// zung 'jug sgyu ma'i gar mkhan gnyen ston pa// tshe gcig sangs rgyas sar gshegs ston pa rje// gtsang ma shangs ston tshul khrims 'bum pa'i zhabs// ye shes phyag rgyas 'debs pa gzhon nu grub// mkhas btsun grub pa'i spyi mos rgyal mtshan 'bum// bsam bzhin srid par sku sprul tshul khrims mgon// mchog gi tsanda'i gzi 'bar ras chen pa// sgyu ma'i bdud rtsis brlan pa rin rgyal ba// rlung sems lha yi skur grub sangs rgyas dpal// bde stong 'od du gsal ba nam mkha' rgyal// snang sems gnyug mar thim pa legs rgyal ba// rdo rje btsun mo'i bdag po grol ba'i mchog /zag med bdes gang chos sku lha dbang grags// he ru ka dpal gsang bdag sgrol ba'i mgon// rgyal tshab ye shes sku can rgya mtsho'i mtshan// brtul zhugs lam du longs pa yon tan mgon// 'ja' lus skur gshegs mgon po dpal 'byor ba// 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid gyur mgon po grags// lhan skyes dga' bas rab myos rnam rgyal mtshan// mkhas grub bye ba'i khyu mchog rig pa 'dzin// pad dkar 'chang dngos phrin las shing rta'i zhabs// dge legs nyams rtogs 'od brgya'i dpal 'bar ba// gnas lugs gter 'byed kun dga' lhun gyis grub// mkha' spyod mdzes mas rtag 'khyud blo gros pa// sbas pa'i sangs rgyas karma lhag mthong rje// rlung sems dbang thob gzhan phan 'od zer can// gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin rtsa ba'i bla ma la// mi phyed gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs// khyod sku gsang 'dus khyod (458)gsung sgyu 'phrul che// khyod thugs dgyes rdor yon tan 'khor lo sdom// phrin las 'jigs mdzad nyid dang dbyer med pa// mkhas grub rgyal po khyung po rnal 'byor gyi// gdams zab gser gyi phreng ba 'dzin rnams la// gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba snying nas 'debs// byin rlabs dngos grub thugs rje'i gting nas stsol// gtum mo'i bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// zhen med sgyu ma rang shar byin gyis rlobs// rmi lam lha skur 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// 'od gsal rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs// 'chugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// bar dor sku gsum thob par byin gyis rlobs// mtshan tsam thos kyang srid ba hrul byed pa// grub chen khyung po'i go 'phang myur thob nas// mkha' khyab 'gro ba 'dren par byin gyis rlobs/

/ces pa 'di'ang nang gi lam du zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyi dpyid grub pa 'jam pa'i dpal gyi bka' stsal dang*// rang nyid kyang gus ba ltung byed pa'i mos pas drangs te gdung shugs kyi khang rang bde ba'i rdo rjes gsol ba btab pa dge legs 'phel/// /
